title: 第5章 乖别怕我最怜香惜玉了第6章 杂碎们想跟我越狱吗
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
陆江河头皮发麻，感觉自己血肉被这些怪物啃食。
目光愕然看着夜洐身后的白骨夫人等人。
看到他们身上捆绑的锁链，看到紧闭的牢门，恐惧消散，露出不屑的笑容：“哈哈哈，为了苟活，你还真给这些邪魔当狗，对自己真够狠的，可惜......这些邪魔，护不住你。”
陆江河得意的靠近牢房。
他很清楚，这些罪犯曾经再强再凶，今日都是没爪子的病虎，没一点威胁。
走到牢门的夜洐，双手抓住玄铁铸造而成的栅栏。
“生气了，想出来？可惜......”陆江河嚣张的声音戛然而止，他看到毛骨悚然的一幕，绝对不可能被罪犯摧毁的牢门，在夜洐双手之下。
玄铁铸造的栅栏，瞬间弯曲，露出可以通行的洞口。
“怎么可能！”守狱人也懵了。
被封住气海的罪犯，绝不可能破坏牢门，这是百年证实的铁律。
“就算出来，你也不是我的对手。”陆江河反应很快，立马握住腰间的刀柄，抽刀劈砍。
一道血迹似刀芒划过。
陆江河怔怔看着自己劈砍而下的手臂。
没有刀！
目光下垂，看到依旧插在刀鞘中的横刀，手也握住刀柄，只剩下手掌。
手腕被斩断。
什么时候？我怎么没感觉。
他怎么这么快这么强，我明明已经达到第二境最高第九层，夜洐在地牢中就算没被封住气海，也不应该是我的对手。
一刹那，无数的念头。
最终被死亡的恐惧所掩盖，惊恐的看着抓住自己，并且拔出自己刀锋的夜洐。

“夜洐，我们曾经是同伴，是生死与共的......”
夜洐随手往后一扔，断手的陆江河被扔进了牢房，扔在众多凶神恶煞的狠人们面前：“好好招待我的兄弟。”
“救我，救.....”陆江河连发出惨叫都没资格，就被凶人们彻底覆盖，只剩下凶人们令人毛骨悚然的狞笑声。
走出牢门的夜洐。
随手两刀，两道漆黑的刀芒，撕开两位守狱人的身体。
只剩下了宫装女子青莲，还活着。
青莲浑身轻微发颤，茫然无措，恐惧的望着夜洐，望着浑身被漆黑魔气环绕的夜洐，与夜洐目光相对。
“青莲姐别怕，你知道我，最怜香惜玉。”夜洐轻声安抚青莲。
青莲浑身抖的更加严重。
她感受到夜洐眼神没有半分温度，既像俯瞰蝼蚁的漠然，也蕴藏毁天灭地的戾气。
无形的压力摧毁了青莲的心理防线，无力跪坐在冰冷的地上。
“青莲姐，可以告诉我，你们今日真正的目的吗？”夜洐杵刀蹲在青莲面前，细语轻声询问：“乖，别怕，别哭。”
温柔的擦拭青莲鹅蛋脸上的泪花。
“我.....我.....我是放你出来的，真的，我真的救你的。”青莲断断续续说道。
不断重复。
想要以此证明自己说的都是真的。
content_en:
Lu Jianghe's scalp was numb, and he felt like his flesh and blood were being eaten by these monsters.
He stared at Madam Bones and others behind Ye Wei in shock.
Seeing the chains tied to their bodies and the closed prison door, their fear dissipated and they showed a disdainful smile: "Hahaha, in order to survive, you really become a dog to these evil spirits. You are really cruel to yourself. It's a pity... these evil spirits can't protect you."
Lu Jianghe approached the cell proudly.
He knew very well that no matter how powerful or vicious these criminals were in the past, today they were just sick tigers without claws and no threat at all.
Ye Hao walked to the cell door and grabbed the fence made of black iron with both hands.
"You're angry and want to come out? What a pity..." Lu Jianghe's arrogant voice stopped suddenly. He saw a horrifying scene. The cell door that could never be destroyed by criminals was under Ye Yi's hands.
The fence made of dark iron instantly bent, revealing a passable hole.
"How is that possible!" The prison guard was also confused.
A criminal who is sealed in the Qi Sea will never be able to destroy the prison door. This is an iron law that has been proven for hundreds of years.
"Even if you come out, you are no match for me." Lu Jianghe reacted quickly, immediately holding the handle of the knife at his waist and slashing with the knife.
A trace of blood was drawn like a knife.
Lu Jianghe stared blankly at his chopped off arm.
No knife!
He lowered his eyes and saw the Heng Dao still inserted in the scabbard. His hand was also holding the handle of the knife, leaving only the palm of his hand.
The wrists were severed.
when? Why don't I feel it?
How could he be so strong so quickly? I have obviously reached the ninth level, the highest level in the second realm. Even if Ye Hui was not sealed in the sea of ​​​​qi in the dungeon, he should not be my opponent.
In one moment, countless thoughts.
In the end, he was overshadowed by the fear of death. He looked at Ye Hui in horror as he grabbed himself and pulled out his own blade.
"Ye Hu, we were once companions, sharing life and death..."
Ye Tao threw it back casually, and the broken-hand Lu Jianghe was thrown into the cell, in front of many fierce and ruthless people: "Enter my brother well."
"Save me, save..." Lu Jianghe didn't even have the qualifications to scream, and was completely covered by the murderers, leaving only the murderous laughter of the murderers.
Ye Zhi walked out of the prison door.
With two swords at hand, two jet-black sword lights tore open the bodies of the two prison guards.
Only Qinglian, a woman in palace attire, is still alive.
Qinglian's whole body was trembling slightly, and she was at a loss. She looked at Ye Tiao with fear, looking at Ye Tiao who was surrounded by dark demonic energy, and met Ye Tiao's eyes.
"Sister Qinglian, don't be afraid. You know that I am the most compassionate person." Ye Hao softly comforted Qinglian.
Qinglian's whole body was shaking even more seriously.
She felt that Ye Ting's eyes had no warmth at all. They were as indifferent as looking down at ants, but they also contained an aura that would destroy the world.
The invisible pressure destroyed Qinglian's psychological defense, and she knelt down on the cold ground helplessly.
"Sister Qinglian, can you tell me your real purpose today?" Ye Huidao squatted in front of Qinglian and asked softly: "Be good, don't be afraid, don't cry."
Gently wipe the tears from Qinglian's oval face.
"I...I...I let you out, really, I really saved you." Qinglian said intermittently.
Keep repeating.
I want to prove that what I said is true.
